title: Evidence Chain Completeness — RFC 3161 Timestamps, Finding Audit Events, CVSS Scores
goal: Make the evidence chain legally complete: enable RFC 3161 external timestamps on every artifact by default, add finding lifecycle audit events so every status change is logged, and add CVSS score fields to findings.
scope: Three concrete changes: (1) RFC 3161 TIMESTAMPS: change evidence_timestamping_enabled default to True in config.py. Add timestamp_token_uri (VARCHAR 512 nullable) and timestamp_verified_at (DATETIME nullable) columns to evidence_artifacts table via Alembic migration. After artifact is stored, call the existing _collect_timestamp() in evidence_integrity.py and save the token URI. (2) FINDING AUDIT EVENTS: in api/app/routers/findings.py, call write_audit_event() with action='finding.created' when a finding is stored, action='finding.status_changed' with old/new status when PATCH changes status, action='finding.false_positive_marked' with reason when status becomes false_positive. (3) CVSS FIELDS: add cvss_score (Float nullable) and cvss_vector (String 64 nullable) to Finding model in control.py. In workers/orchestration/findings.py, populate these fields from nuclei tool output (nuclei includes cvss-score and cvss-metrics in its JSONL output) and ZAP output (risk score field). Show CVSS score in Findings drawer if present.
generation_reason: RFC 3161 timestamp column does not exist in DB. Zero finding audit events in 3050 total events. CVSS field missing. These three gaps prevent the system from being legally defensible.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Evidence chain and CVSS only. No new API endpoints beyond what is needed.

success_criteria: timestamp_token_uri column exists in evidence_artifacts after migration.
New artifacts get RFC 3161 timestamp token stored.
Finding creation generates finding.created audit event.
Finding status change generates finding.status_changed audit event with old/new status.
cvss_score and cvss_vector columns exist on findings table.
Nuclei findings with CVSS data have cvss_score populated.
out_of_scope: Mandatory CVSS for all findings retroactively

acceptance_criteria: Timestamps stored on artifacts. Finding events in audit log. CVSS fields populated from nuclei output.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
